quote_json: "the array initializer must have as many levels of nesting as there are"
notes: ed1-19.6-013: A diagnostic (reject) at ISO-1 for `int[,,] cells = {};`, `static byte[,,] cells = { {}, {}, {} };` and `new long[,,,] {}`; the full-depth controls compile and print OK 0. Existing tests that rely on the zero-length assumption belong to the later level. The exact original and positive witness were observed once at levels 1 and 7.3; the latter level is comparative evidence, not an assertion of first-edition authority there. Failing originals do not prove mutation sensitivity.
